assignment.title: Investigate water balance
assignment.objective: Explain water movement using a controlled comparison.
assignment.question: How does external solute concentration change cell volume?

entry.title: Osmosis Lab
entry.subject: biology

trialData.stage: Initially hypertonic. Net water movement out of the cell. The cell is flaccid.

entry.observations: Research question: How does the surrounding solution change a cell’s volume?

model.assumptions: Teaching model at 25 °C: water crosses; solute does not. The cell starts at 300 mOsm/L, solute amount is conserved and the bath is effectively infinite. Wall stiffness and the animal-cell lysis threshold are illustrative; the diagram is not to scale.
model.limitations: Model outputs are simulated observations, not calibrated measurements of a living organism.
